Claire (CS): Taro from SentinelAI requested APAC demo prep for a partner showcase next Friday. Ask: ap-southeast-1 region pin, IPs 203.0.113.250/32 and 198.51.100.6/32, CORS https://partners.sentinel.ai, scoped demo key model=v2-small, retention=0, window 2026-05-14 10:00-13:00 SGT, qps=320. Can infra/security confirm? @Ben @Inez @Kyle
Taro (SentinelAI): Confirming. We'll have ~35 attendees, streaming enabled. Token should expire 4h after window and only allow generation calls (no fine-tuning). Also would like traffic isolation for the demo.
Ben (Eng Infra): We can create a pinned route in ap-southeast-1 and failover to ap-northeast-1. For 320 qps + streaming, recommend reserve 3x g4dn equivalents and autoscale to 5. I'll queue the reservation. Need signed Demo Agreement before prod ACL.
Inez (SRE): Reserving 3 nodes now; autoscale min=3 max=5, scale trigger p95 latency>650ms for 2m. Staging ACL updated with provided IPs. Will push prod ACL after CS confirms signed doc. Alerts set for cpu>72%, p95 latency>700ms, error-rate>0.5%.
Kyle (Security): We'll scope token to the two /32s and to model=v2-small, set expires=2026-05-14T17:00:00Z, retention=0, and disable request-body logging. Require signed Demo Agreement + quick security addendum. Recommend mTLS if partner supports it. Opening SEC ticket SEC-8331.
Claire (CS): Sending Demo Agreement + security addendum to Taro now. Taro, please sign and return by EOD tomorrow so we can issue the scoped token 24h before the demo. Sales flagged this account as "renewal opportunity"; good demo helps.
ops-bot: Route reservation created: route-sentinelai-ap-southeast-1 queued at 4319999994 by Inez (SRE)
Taro (SentinelAI): We'll sign and upload to the secure share today. One more question: can you limit the demo key to only the specified origin and prevent reuse elsewhere?
Kyle (Security): Yes  we'll set token scope: allowed_cors=["https://partners.sentinel.ai"], allowed_ips=["203.0.113.250/32","198.51.100.6/32"], model="v2-small", expires=2026-05-14T17:00:00Z, retention=0, debug=false.
Inez (SRE): Once Claire confirms signed docs I'll push prod ACL and hand over the token. I'll monitor the window live; ping #eng-sre during the demo and I'll respond.
Claire (CS): Thanks team. Taro, after you upload the signed doc I'll confirm prod ACL push and send the scoped demo key. Good luck with the showcase!
